newsitem.title: UK: LME kerb ends mixed, copper slides but zinc higher.
newsitem.headline: LME kerb ends mixed, copper slides but zinc higher.

text.p: COPPER - Ends lower in thin volumes. Off $27 at $2,273. Cash threes down to $60/$65 back versus $100 as tight nearbys unwind.
ZINC - Up $7 at $1,551, cash/threes back flares to $17.
ALUMINIUM - Finishes $27 stronger at $1,642, extending AM rally. Cash/threes contango tighter. NICKEL - Slightly higher.
TIN - Barely changed. LEAD - Up with zinc. ALLOY - Quiet.
